For each Database node linked to the Data Map - a Database source sending to it, or a Database destination it sends to, directly or through nodes without tables - how the tables in the Data Map's source.json (destination.json) differ from the node's schema.json, table by table, matched by name. Tables the user said not to ask about again are left out. Nothing is written.
